messages.subject: Wiki results column please?
parts:
Hi GSOC-R 2012 mentors,

Now that GSOC 2012 is over, it would nice to have a summary of results
on the R wiki page so we can use that to plan next year's projects.

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2012

I have created a new column Results on the Project Ideas table. Can
each mentor please add the following information under the results
column?

- A link to where the developed code can be found (github, R-forge, a
.zip file, etc)

- A sentence about what the code does.

- A sentence about if the project is completely finished or if there
is potentially more work for a student next year.

This will help enormously when we organize ideas for GSOC 2013 next
year.

Thanks very much!
